configuration.flop_convention: 1 multiply-add=2 FLOPs; exact dispatched GEMM, matmul, attention QK/AV and convolution FLOPs; excludes normalization, activations, elementwise Rank2, softmax, topk, bias and data movement; per image
configuration.timing_convention: per-call host wall-clock with CUDA synchronize, median and p95; separately queued throughput; input GPU-resident; includes topk score for reported pipeline scopes
configuration.diagnostics: Report exact raw training script forward separately; main inference copy removes diagnostic reductions and GPU-to-CPU scalar transfers only; verify outputs close for batch1 and16
configuration.size: FP32 tensor payload and actual torch.save(state_dict) byte count in memory, core and full teacher pipeline; no optimizer; MB and MiB explicitly distinguished
configuration.teacher: 85,641,216 parameters, frozen but required during inference; pretrained weights loaded from local timm cache offline
configuration.scope: single audit comparing existing registered architectures; no training, no new model variants, no test/AUC optimization
configuration.model_definition: Per user clarification: teacher + OCBE + student + top-k scoring is the entire model. Behavior branch is historical code and outside this model.
